candidate_note: Candidate built 2026-09-10 from a quiesced tree at d5f39aa11610 (tree 8f503cfbaae2): `git status --porcelain` was empty before the build and after it, so the commit and tree above describe the source that produced these exact bytes rather than approximately describing it. The digest was re-measured from the file and checked against the .sha256 sidecar; the detached signature verifies against 8F13CE1535EE1F4A2916A1F73C5C900B7BE80CA1. source_gate, package_gate and iso_gate all PASSED against this candidate. Every case below is still `pending` and evidence_bundle_sha256 is still null, because neither has been produced yet: `verify` refuses this manifest today, and should. The case list is carried over from 4.0.0 -- what a release must prove does not change because the version did -- and every RESULT was dropped rather than copied. Three TITLES did have to change, and carrying them verbatim had already got them wrong: ISO-01 asked for "exact embedded 4.0 packages", PUB-01 for "the same verified 4.0 release", and UPGRADE-01 for an upgrade from 3.5 alone -- which is the suite the published APT tree actually serves, so it is not the optional half, but 4.0 installed from the published ISO is a real source version too and both are now named.
